answer: Pedestrian deaths in NYC fell from a 13-year high of 176 in 2013 to 119 in 2025, averaging 130 per year (1,690 total). After the 2013 peak, deaths settled into a 101-149 band — the low was 101 in 2020 (pandemic driving) and 107 in 2023, with a slight rebound to 135 in 2022; the last three years (2023-2025: 107, 124, 119) are all below average.
